'''Vora Futboll Klub''' is an Albanian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Vorë]]. Founded in 1989, the club spent much of its early history competing in the lower divisions of Albanian football before achieving a rapid rise through the 2010s and 2020s. During the [[2024–25 Kategoria e Parë|2024–25 season]], the club earned its first ever promotion to [[Kategoria Superiore]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Armillotta |first1=Giovanni |title=Almanaku i Futbollit Shqiptar 1930–2024 |date=2024 |publisher=Ledizioni |page=46}}</ref>"}}
